description: List campaigns in an ad account, optionally filtered by name search and status. Search matches campaign names only; to find ad sets or ads by name, call ads_list_adsets or ads_list_ads without a parent ID. Use fields to return only the columns you need; large pages are trimmed to fit the output budget.

after.description: Opaque paging.after cursor. Keep filters unchanged.

fields.description: Return only these output columns. id is always returned; money fields also keep their Minor twin and currency. status is the configured state; effectiveStatus is the effective delivery state. Either is null when Meta does not provide it. Omit for all columns; an empty array returns only id.

fresh.description: Accepted for compatibility; this list always reads fresh data.

offset.description: Offset within the fetched results. Requests fetch up to 500 rows. After budget trimming, use pagination.nextOffset with the same input after; consume remaining rows before following paging.after.

status.description: Exact 'active' filters active/in-process delivery states (default); other values mean no status filter on existing campaign and parent-scoped lists.

name: ads_list_campaigns
title: List Campaigns
